comparison.objective: Saw a marked 45-degree mitre while holding moulding against a fence; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual workpiece restraint and repeated guided sawing versus small-tool insertion, collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and guarded test actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Moulding cut through at the marked angle and tool/workpiece cleared versus two compliant impact cycles without bottoming or limit violations.
comparison.reason: Shared iterative motion does not equate guided cutting with closed-loop impact-response tuning.
